# K0 policy status overrides / notes. Format: <ID> <STATUS|=> ;; note
GOV-015 = ;; Matched by CLAUDE.md § Git and git-workflow; enforcement note: the pre-command hook returns an 'ask' decision for repository-changing Git commands (table-driven classifier; read-only commands run). Open related item: UNCERTAIN-K0-0001 — git-workflow runs high-risk operations (reset --hard, clean, push --force, push --force-with-lease, branch deletion, rebasing shared history) "only when explicitly requested or required by an approved workflow"; whether the second alternative widens GOV-015's "explicitly requested" condition is LINK_UNCERTAIN (see ORPHAN_SWEEP_REPORT.md).
DEP-025 = ;; Enforcement note: the fail-closed pre-command hook denies package-changing commands that lack the trailing '# add-dependency: reviewed' marker and adds a peer-conflict instruction when --force/-f/--legacy-peer-deps is present; a command carrying the self-declared marker is not denied even with a force flag (marker mechanism EXTRA).
DEP-003 = ;; Enforcement note: package changes are denied until re-run with the self-declared review marker (EXTRA); check-dependencies reports empty, '*' and range ([ ] ( )) NuGet versions as errors and prerelease versions as notices ('allowed only when explicitly requested'), and npm empty/'*'/'latest'/'x'/wildcard versions as errors; caret/tilde npm ranges are not flagged.
DEP-004 = ;; Enforcement note: check-dependencies reports Microsoft.Extensions.Http.Polly, Polly.Extensions.Http, Serilog.Sinks.Elasticsearch and FluentValidation.AspNetCore as deprecated errors (EXTRA list); license and vulnerability checks rest on the add-dependency procedure.
ARC-001 = ;; Enforcement note: the pre-command hook denies dotnet project-reference commands without the '# project-references: approved' marker (EXTRA; changing the reference graph is Reserved); after edits/shell commands the hook reports changed .csproj references as Reserved and runs check-dependencies, which errors on outward layer references, production→test references and missing referenced projects (non-blocking feedback; exit 1 in manual runs); test-project references produce notices only.
WF-010 = ;; Enforcement note: the code-reviewer agent disallows Write, Edit, MultiEdit and NotebookEdit; shell tools are not disallowed, so read-only shell behaviour rests on the instruction text; check-instructions verifies the agent's existence, name, loading and delegation to code-review but not its disallowed tools.
RUN-010 = ;; Enforcement note: .editorconfig sets IDE0005 to warning and Directory.Build.props sets AnalysisLevel latest without EnforceCodeStyleInBuild, so unused usings surface as editor/analyzer warnings; removal in changed files rests on the verify workflow.
WF-006 = ;; Matched as DEFAULT (verify § Runtime smoke); the swagger skill states API-change verification steps (start the API, open Swagger UI) with MUST strength, and container/pipeline verification checklists are registered as EXTRA.
PST-008 = ;; Enforcement note: at Stop the hook reminds once per material state when Domain/persistence model files changed without a seeder change, but only when a DbSeeder.cs exists in backend/.
GOV-021 = ;; Enforcement note: the post-change hook returns feedback to run custom-settings when CUSTOM_SETTINGS.md changes, and the Stop hook reminds once per state.
ARC-020 = ;; Matched by CLAUDE.md § Decisions; K0 adds further Reserved categories (project reference graph changes, search/external storage/external identity infrastructure, new major libraries, any project-wide convention or abstraction, adopting API versioning) and a LangVersion/target-framework approval gate in modern-csharp, recorded as EXTRA.
GOV-017 = ;; Shared invariant. CLAUDE.md § Decisions defines Decided/Delegated/Reserved, the Reserved minimum list, the unclear-case test, the Decision Request fields and headless handling, with the imported decision register as the Decided record (oracle-linked); K0 adds explicit-instruction approvals with mandatory recording, register entry/ADR/supersession rules, Affects propagation, and reporting of Delegated decisions in the development-workflow output (EXTRA).
GOV-018 = ;; Shared invariant. CLAUDE.md § Engineering defaults requires naming a material concern (including duplication, cohesion, trigger/loading problems, context cost, conflict with accepted decisions, unnecessary complexity) and proposing an alternative before implementing, never silently rewriting or ignoring the requirement; development-workflow checks each request against this obligation.
